name: Subsistence Allowance (Sainik Welfare)
benefit:
- ₹10,000 per month for Second World War (WWII) Veterans, irrespective of financial status. 
- ₹9,000 per month for Non-pensioners ESM above 60 years under "Below Poverty Line (BPL)".
- ₹9,000 per month for widows of the above two categories.

*The amount is credited to the beneficiary’s Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be an [Ex-Serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen) or the Widow of an Ex-Serviceman.- The applicant should be [registered](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure) with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry.
